# Model options matrix

<!-- Generated by `python -m arctic_platform.common.option_registry matrix --write`. Do not edit by hand. -->

One row per option, one column per model profile (one profile per loader). `yes` means the model
supports the option in some context, `no` that it does not, and `n/a` that its architecture rules the
option out. Restrictions that depend on the platform, the parallelism or the value stay in each
loader's own validation. The reasons follow the table.

| Option | Runs in | Goal | `generic_moe` | `glm5_next` | `glm_moe_dsa` | `huggingface` | `qwen3_5_moe` | `qwen4_exp` |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `attention.backend` | trainer | speed | no | no | no | yes | no | no |
| `attention.sparse_mla` | trainer | speed | n/a | no | yes | no | n/a | n/a |
| `checkpointing.freq` | trainer | memory | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| `checkpointing.mode` | trainer | memory | yes | yes | yes | no | yes | yes |
| `checkpointing.offload` | trainer | memory | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| `checkpointing.targets` | trainer | memory | yes | yes | yes | no | yes | yes |
| `compile.fullgraph` | trainer | speed | no | no | no | yes | no | no |
| `liger` | trainer | speed | no | no | no | yes | no | no |
| `lm_head.cross_entropy` | trainer | memory | yes | yes | yes | no | yes | yes |
| `lm_head.fp32` | both | parity | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| `lm_head.token_chunk_size` | trainer | memory | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| `lm_head.vocab_chunk_size` | trainer | memory | no | no | no | yes | no | no |
| `moe.comm_backend` | trainer | speed | yes | yes | yes | n/a | yes | yes |

| `moe.comm_token_chunk` | trainer | speed | yes | yes | yes | n/a | yes | yes |

## Options

- `attention.backend`: The attention implementation to run. Today: `ModelSpec.attn_implementation`.
- `attention.sparse_mla`: The sparse MLA attention kernel. Today: `loader_options.sparse_mla_backend`.
- `checkpointing.freq`: Checkpoint every Nth block. Today: `patches.gradient_checkpointing`; `loader_options.ac_config.freq`.
- `checkpointing.mode`: Recompute whole blocks or only selected submodules in the backward pass. Today: `loader_options.ac_config.mode`.
- `checkpointing.offload`: Stream checkpointed block boundaries to CPU memory. Today: `patches.activation_offload`; `loader_options.ac_config.offload_config`.
- `checkpointing.targets`: The submodules that selective checkpointing recomputes. Today: `loader_options.ac_config.targets`.
- `compile.fullgraph`: Compile each transformer layer with torch.compile, as one full graph when set. Today: `patches.compile.fullgraph`.
- `liger`: Apply the Liger kernels (RMSNorm, SwiGLU and fused linear cross-entropy) to a HuggingFace model. Today: `patches.liger`.
- `lm_head.cross_entropy`: Fuse the LM head with the cross-entropy so the full logits are never materialized. Today: `loader_options.fused_cross_entropy`.
- `lm_head.fp32`: Compute the LM-head projection in fp32, so trainer and sampler log-probs agree. Today: `patches.lm_head.fp32`; `loader_options.fp32_lm_head`; sampler `ARCTIC_FP32_LM_HEAD`.
- `lm_head.token_chunk_size`: Token tile size of the chunked LM-head projection. Today: `patches.lm_head.token_chunk_size`; `loader_options.fused_lm_head_token_chunk_size`.
- `lm_head.vocab_chunk_size`: Vocabulary tile size of the chunked LM-head projection. Today: `patches.lm_head.vocab_chunk_size`.
- `moe.comm_backend`: The expert-parallel all-to-all backend. Today: `loader_options.ep_comm_backend`.
- `moe.comm_sms`: Streaming multiprocessors reserved for expert-parallel communication. Today: `loader_options.deepep_num_sms`.
- `moe.comm_token_chunk`: Token chunk size of the expert-parallel dispatch. Today: `loader_options.deepep_token_chunk_size`.
- `moe.grouped_mm`: Run the experts as one grouped matmul. Today: `loader_options.moe_use_grouped_mm`.
- `numerics.reduce_dtype`: The dtype gradients are reduced in. Today: `loader_options.reduce_dtype`.
- `peft`: Train adapters (LoRA) instead of the full weights. Today: `patches.peft`.
- `tiled_mlp.token_chunk_size`: Recompute the MLP in token tiles of this size. Today: `patches.tiled_mlp.token_chunk_size`; `loader_options.tiled_mlp_token_chunk_size`.
- `zorro_train`: Replace the forward with the ZoRRo Train log-prob and entropy path. Today: `patches.zorro_train`.

## `generic_moe`

6 of 20 options unsupported.

- `attention.backend` (no): no loader option; the backend is `ModelSpec.attn_implementation`, checked by the loader
- `attention.sparse_mla` (n/a): no model family behind this loader uses sparse MLA attention
- `compile.fullgraph` (no): the loader rejects `patches.compile`
- `liger` (no): the loader rejects `patches.liger`; set `lm_head.cross_entropy` to liger instead
- `lm_head.vocab_chunk_size` (no): no equivalent option
- `peft` (no): the loader rejects `patches.peft`: expert adapter integration is not yet supported
- `zorro_train` (no): the loader rejects `patches.zorro_train`

## `huggingface`

5 of 20 options unsupported.

- `attention.sparse_mla` (no): no equivalent option; sparse MLA is used only by the GLM loaders glm_moe_dsa and glm5_next
- `checkpointing.mode` (no): no equivalent option; `patches.gradient_checkpointing` always recomputes whole layers
- `checkpointing.targets` (no): no equivalent option; selective checkpointing exists only in the custom loaders
- `lm_head.cross_entropy` (no): no equivalent option; the fused cross-entropy comes only with `patches.liger`
- `moe.comm_backend` (n/a): the huggingface loader rejects expert parallelism and has no expert options
- `moe.comm_sms` (n/a): the huggingface loader rejects expert parallelism and has no expert options
- `moe.comm_token_chunk` (n/a): the huggingface loader rejects expert parallelism and has no expert options
- `moe.grouped_mm` (n/a): the huggingface loader rejects expert parallelism and has no expert options
- `numerics.reduce_dtype` (no): no equivalent option
